wiki.title: Matthew Deneen
wiki.extract: Matthew Darin Deneen (born September 19, 1968) is an American politician from Kentucky. He is a member of the Republican Party and has represented District 10 in the Kentucky Senate since January 1, 2023. Deneen resides in Elizabethtown, Kentucky.
